_about: Settings for the review window (app/gui/settings.py). Folder paths are relative to the project folder unless absolute.
_working_folder: Where the file list looks for claim files. A placeholder for the eventual email-based intake (blueprint section 3).
_file_extensions: Which files the left list shows (the working folder only, not its sub-folders — D41): PDFs, photos or screenshots (JPG, PNG, HEIC; an image is one page). Claim sheets arrive as PDFs for now; Excel files are not read (D39).
_pdf_render_dpi: Resolution PDF pages are rendered at, for OCR and for display alike (one coordinate frame for both). The OCR enhancement rules were measured on 300 dpi renders; change both together.
_zoom: Ctrl + mouse wheel on the page zooms by zoom_step per notch, within min_zoom..max_zoom of the page's actual size.
_sizes: Starting widths in pixels, shared out in proportion to the window until the officer drags a divider: files, receipts (with their header above them), claim sheet (with the status cards under it) — about 11 %, 36 %, 53 % (owner, D41, D42).
_shutdown_wait_seconds: On closing, how long to wait for a page that is mid-OCR to finish before the background thread is stopped by force.
_read_ahead: When nothing else needs the OCR engine, read the other files in the working folder in the background, in list order, so they are ready when opened. Results are identical either way; it only changes when reading happens. Opening a file takes over after the page being read finishes (up to one page's reading time).
_display_dpi: Resolution pages are drawn at on screen. Lower than pdf_render_dpi to keep memory light; highlights stay exact because they are placed in the OCR's own page pixels.
_page_gap_px: Space between pages in the continuous scroll view, in page pixels.
_render_margin_pages: Pages drawn beyond those on screen, above and below; pages further away are released from memory.
_highlight_colours: One colour per searched key (user decision: amount blue, date purple, PIN teal).
_alphas: Opacity 0-255: fill inside a matched value; outline of its neighbouring segments on the same row.
_highlight_line_px: Outline width on screen, in screen pixels (stays the same at any zoom).
_tour: The Auto tour (D31): starts by itself when a claim has been checked; lingers green_ms on a green amount, yellow_ms on a yellow or red one.
_status_colours: The status dots, the page badges, the row buttons and the tint of an amount that failed (owner: green verified; yellow a receipt whose date or amount does not match; red no valid receipt — D34). Receipt highlights keep highlight_colours.
_sheet_view: The claim sheet shown as its PDF (D36, D39): cropped to its printed area plus margin_frac of the page on each side, fitted to the pane's width. row_button_frac: a row's button as a share of the row's height. tint_alpha (0-255): how strongly an amount that failed is tinted in its colour. current_colour / current_line_px: the outline of the row in view and of the amount shown. label_height_frac: the 'No receipt found' text as a share of the row's height.
_status_cards: The three cards under the claim sheet (D42): how strongly each is tinted in its status colour (0-255) and the size of its large words.
_ocr_export_path: Optional JSON snapshot of OCR readings. Empty disables export and preserves the original memory-only behaviour. Example: outputs/ocr_readings.json.
_badge: The solid badge in each receipt page's top-right corner (D35): its text size and padding on screen (it stays the same size at any zoom) and its text colour; the fill is the page's status colour.
_company_pin: Where the company's Kenyan PIN is kept (D23): a git-ignored file at the project root, KEY=value lines; the first PIN listed is searched. Never shown, logged or committed.
